200.description: A list of survey answer with related fields included

id.description: A unique numeric ID identifying the answer

answerId.description: An ID that uniquely identifies the answer

answerComment.description: A comment given by the participating employee for the given question

answerLocale.description: A locale that was detected based on the answers given during the survey. If possible the language of questionText will match this.

answerScore.description: The score given by participating employee for the given question

answerSkipReason.description: If the question was skipped, this field contain the reason

answerText.description: If the question should be answered with text and not a score, this field contain the answer given

categoryGroup.description: The set of questions that the asked question belong to

categoryId.description: An ID that uniquely identifies the category/driver that the asked question belong to

categoryStandard.description: Can be used to identify built-in categories/drivers across companies

companyId.description: An ID that uniquely identifies the company

employeeExternalId.description: A company-specified ID that can used to identify an employee

employeeId.description: An ID that uniquely identifies the employee

questionId.description: An ID that uniquely identifies the asked question. Each question has translations so that questionText in different locales ties into the same questionId.

questionText.description: The text of the question being asked. The language of questionText will match answerLocale. Default is the question text seen in the Peakon product.

responseAnsweredAt.description: The time when the survey response was submitted

responseId.description: An ID that uniquely identifies the asked response

roundEnd.description: A date for when the survey round ended

roundId.description: An ID that uniquely identifies the round

roundOpensAt.description: A date for when the survey round opened

roundType.description: Is "test" if the survey is a test survey. "automatic" otherwise.

scheduleContextName.description: The name of the Company or Segment that the schedule is for

scheduleId.description: An ID that uniquely identifies the schedule

id.description: The JWT token to use in the Authorization header of subsequent requests
